name: @dsh-toolset/herdr-use
description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 进程内集成插件：把 herdr 的 pane 当作可控伪终端层（建 pane / 注入文本与按键 / 取屏 / 等输出 / 进程探活 / 关闭），驱动需要屏幕状态与按键时序的交互式命令

scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf ../tmp/cov-herdr-use && mkdir -p ../tmp/cov-herdr-use && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=../tmp/cov-herdr-use node --experimental-transform-types --test 'tests/*.test.ts' 'tests/integration/*.test.ts' && node ../dev/coverage/report.mjs tmp/cov-herdr-use tmp/cov-herdr-use/report.json
